name: Dominated By: Sadistic Delinquent
source:
You're the only one attending Hachino University on a scholarship, which makes you an outcast and bully victim due to the prestigious nature of the university. The only other outcast is a violent, sadistic delinquent who's obsessed with teasing you with her thighs. With your life on the line, you succumb to her threats and become her slave, how will you endure her sadistic plans for you?
